answer: Each seat binds to one ITU amateur callsign plus a 150 POA lock. Mid-epoch the licensee sends a 20-second FT8 of H(epoch-seed || call) in a hash-derived slot, phase-locked to the NCDXF 14.100 MHz beacon. Three SDRs using ferrous loop cores must copy it. A second key on the same call, or two bursts whose Doppler and Maidenhead square agree within 0.3 ppm and one grid, burns 75 POA and merges both claims. Windows last a documented 90-second morning zephyr opening so skywave pre-records cannot be spliced in. WAVs stay public four epochs; leftover stake returns after three sealed answers.
